title: The Daily Compass｜每日罗盘
subtitle: A bilingual daily briefing for navigating global news, culture, AI, and social change.
theme: 热浪、身体与基础设施竞争：气候风险、生殖政治、矿业劳动、文化再叙事与AI时代教育
sourcePolicy: 本期采用用户指定来源池中可核验发布日期与原文链接的报道；8条来源均为 The Guardian。正文采用直接叙述，来源统一列于文末。
introChinese: 今天的小报关键词是：“heat, bodies, and infrastructure competition（热浪、身体与基础设施竞争）”。欧洲极端高温和委内瑞拉地震把城市安全推到前台；生殖政治、矿业性骚扰和过热住房提醒我们，身体总是在制度里承受风险；艺术和教育则分别回应气候危机与 AI 时代；太空卫星网络也成为新的技术主权战场。

items.title: 欧洲多国发布极端高温警告：热浪正在考验城市韧性
items.summaryChinese: 英国、法国和意大利等地继续面临极端高温预警，英国6月高温纪录可能连续第二天被打破。热浪不是单纯的天气事件，它会同时影响医院、铁路、住房、能源、电网和户外劳动。气候危机最现实的样子，往往不是遥远的平均温度曲线，而是人们能否在家里、车厢里、工作场所里安全度过一天。
items.correspondingEnglish: Warnings were issued across the UK, France and Italy as Europe braced for another day of extreme heat. The UK’s June heat record could be broken for a second consecutive day. A heatwave is not only a weather event. It tests hospitals, railways, housing, energy systems and outdoor work. Climate risk becomes real when people ask whether they can get through the day safely.

englishExpressions.example: Extreme heat can put pressure on hospitals and transport systems.
Authorities issued a heat warning for several regions.
Urban resilience depends on housing, energy and public health planning.

items.studyNote: brace for 表示“为困难或冲击做准备”，常用于天气、经济和冲突新闻。

items.title: 委内瑞拉首都遭遇双重地震：灾害响应与建筑安全同时受检验
items.summaryChinese: 委内瑞拉首都加拉加斯遭遇两次强震，建筑倒塌，官方宣布进入紧急状态。地震把一个城市的隐藏结构瞬间暴露出来：建筑标准、救援能力、医院容量、通信系统和国际援助通道都会被同时检验。灾害发生时，真正被测试的不是单一机构，而是一整套公共安全基础设施。
items.correspondingEnglish: Caracas was hit by two powerful earthquakes, with buildings collapsing and a state of emergency declared. Earthquakes expose the hidden structure of a city: building standards, rescue capacity, hospital space, communications and aid channels are tested at once. A disaster does not test only one agency. It tests the whole infrastructure of public safety.

englishExpressions.example: The government declared a state of emergency after the earthquake.
Building standards can determine how a city survives an earthquake.
Rescue capacity matters in the first hours after a disaster.

items.studyNote: capacity 在公共政策中常指系统或机构实际处理问题的能力。

items.title: 美国胚胎“儿童化”争议：生殖政治进入语言和法律边界
items.summaryChinese: 特朗普政府一份关于胚胎收养项目的文件把冷冻胚胎称为 children，引发关于胎儿人格化的担忧。这个争议的关键不只是一个词，而是语言如何为法律变化铺路：当胚胎被描述为儿童，生殖医疗、试管婴儿、堕胎权和家庭选择都会进入新的政治压力之下。身体自主往往先在词语里被重新定义。
items.correspondingEnglish: A Trump administration document on an embryo adoption program refers to frozen embryos as children, raising concerns about fetal personhood. The issue is not only a word choice. Language can prepare the ground for legal change. If embryos are framed as children, IVF, abortion rights and family decisions may face new political pressure.

englishExpressions.example: The document refers to frozen embryos as children.

englishExpressions.meaningChinese: 胎儿人格化；胎儿法律人格
englishExpressions.example: Fetal personhood has become a contested legal idea.
Reproductive rights can be reshaped through legal language.

items.studyNote: personhood 是法律和伦理讨论中的高频词，指某个实体是否被承认为“人”并拥有法律权利。

items.title: Fortescue女性员工发起集体诉讼：偏远矿区里的性骚扰与劳动安全
items.summaryChinese: 澳大利亚 Fortescue 的女性工人发起集体诉讼，指称偏远矿区存在性骚扰和不安全住宿环境。一名女性称曾在飞进飞出式住宿房间里发现男性，另一人称自己曾被男性“嚎叫”骚扰。矿业劳动常被描述为资源、工资和生产效率，但这起诉讼提醒我们：工作场所安全也包括住宿、夜间空间、性别权力和投诉机制。
items.correspondingEnglish: Female workers have brought a class action against Fortescue, alleging sexual harassment and unsafe conditions at remote mine sites. One woman said she found a man in her room at fly-in, fly-out accommodation, while another described being howled at. Workplace safety includes housing, night-time spaces, gendered power and complaint systems, not only machinery and wages.

englishExpressions.example: Female workers filed a class action over conditions at mine sites.
Remote mine sites can create specific safety risks for workers.
Workplace safety includes protection from harassment.

items.studyNote: fly-in, fly-out 指矿业等行业中工人飞往偏远工地轮班、再飞回家的工作模式。

sections.heading: 艺术、时尚与媒体 / Art, Fashion & Media

items.title: Frida Kahlo再被观看：当艺术家变成可消费的反抗符号
items.summaryChinese: 伦敦大型展览重新审视 Frida Kahlo，但评论指出，她复杂、粗粝、政治化的一面常被礼品店式的“品牌 Frida”遮住。Kahlo 的形象被广泛用作抵抗、女性力量和个人风格的符号，可是符号越流行，真实的人和作品就越容易被简化。艺术观看的任务，是把偶像重新还给复杂性。
items.correspondingEnglish: A major London exhibition revisits Frida Kahlo as critics ask whether the marketable brand of Frida has obscured the real artist. Her image has become a symbol of resistance, female strength and personal style. Yet the more a symbol circulates, the more easily the person and the work can be simplified. Looking at art means returning complexity to the icon.

englishExpressions.example: The marketable brand can obscure the complexity of the artist.
Kahlo’s image became a symbol of resistance.
The exhibition tries to return complexity to a familiar icon.

items.studyNote: obscure 作动词时表示“遮蔽、使不清楚”，常用于文化评论和政治分析。

items.title: 气候危机进入音乐剧：浪漫喜剧和酷儿歌舞如何讲述地球困境
items.summaryChinese: Hot Mess 与 Acid’s Reign 等新作品把气候危机带入音乐剧、浪漫喜剧和酷儿歌舞形式之中。它们没有只用灾难感召唤观众，而是尝试用幽默、亲密关系和希望来谈论行星危机。气候文化不一定总是沉重的纪录片或末日叙事，也可以是让观众愿意靠近问题的舞台语言。
items.correspondingEnglish: A new wave of musical theatre, including Hot Mess and Acid’s Reign, is exploring the climate crisis through romcom and queer cabaret forms. These works do not rely only on disaster. They use humor, intimacy and hope to bring audiences closer to planetary crisis. Climate culture can be playful without becoming unserious.

englishExpressions.example: The musical explores the climate crisis through comedy.
Queer cabaret can turn climate anxiety into performance.

englishExpressions.meaningChinese: 行星级危机；全球生态危机
englishExpressions.example: Art can make a planetary crisis feel emotionally close.

items.studyNote: playful without becoming unserious 是很有用的评论句式：有趣，但并不轻浮。

sections.heading: 人工智能与科技 / AI & Tech

items.title: 英国童军推出AI与数字时代徽章：技术素养成为青少年教育的一部分
items.summaryChinese: 英国 Explorer Scouts 为14至18岁青少年推出 AI、内容创作和网络安全等新徽章。传统童军技能常让人想到生火、野外生存和团队协作；现在，数字身份、信息安全和 AI 工具也被纳入“生活技能”。这说明技术素养不再只是电脑课内容，而是青年参与社会、保护自己和理解权力的一部分。
items.correspondingEnglish: Explorer Scouts in the UK have launched new badges for teenagers covering AI, content creation and online safety. Scouting skills once suggested fires, outdoor survival and teamwork. Now digital identity, information safety and AI tools are also treated as life skills. Digital literacy is becoming part of how young people participate in society and protect themselves.

englishExpressions.example: Digital literacy is becoming a basic life skill.
The badge teaches teenagers about online safety.
Content creation is now part of youth digital education.

items.studyNote: literacy 不只指识字，也可表示某领域的基本理解和实践能力，如 media literacy、AI literacy。

items.title: 中国SpaceSail能否挑战Starlink：卫星网络成为技术主权基础设施
items.summaryChinese: 中国 SpaceSail 拥有数百颗低地球轨道卫星，并获得国家支持，已被报道称正与多个国家洽谈。它能否挑战 Elon Musk 的 Starlink，取决于发射规模、国际合作、价格、监管和地缘政治信任。卫星互联网不是单纯商业产品，而是通信、国家安全、灾害响应和数字主权的基础设施。
items.correspondingEnglish: China’s SpaceSail has several hundred low Earth orbit satellites, state backing and reported talks with many countries. Whether it can rival Elon Musk’s Starlink depends on launch scale, partnerships, pricing, regulation and geopolitical trust. Satellite internet is not only a commercial product. It is infrastructure for communication, national security, disaster response and digital sovereignty.

englishExpressions.example: SpaceSail is building a low Earth orbit satellite network.
Satellite internet can connect remote regions.
Satellite networks have become part of digital sovereignty.

items.studyNote: sovereignty 原指主权；technological/digital sovereignty 指国家或地区对关键技术系统的掌控能力。

englishParagraph.english: Today’s news shows how climate, bodies and infrastructure are now deeply connected. Extreme heat and earthquakes test cities before political speeches can explain them. Reproductive language and workplace harassment show how bodies are governed through law, labor and everyday space. Culture tries to rescue complexity from familiar icons and turn climate anxiety into performance. AI badges and satellite networks remind us that the future is being built through education, communication and control.
englishParagraph.chinese: 今天的新闻让我们看到，气候、身体和基础设施已经深深连在一起。极端高温和地震在政治语言解释之前，就先测试了城市；生殖语言和工作场所性骚扰说明，身体会通过法律、劳动和日常空间被治理；文化试图从熟悉的偶像中救回复杂性，也把气候焦虑变成表演；AI徽章和卫星网络则提醒我们，未来正在通过教育、通信和控制被建造出来。

keywords.meaning: 城市韧性；城市面对灾害、气候和系统冲击时维持运行与恢复的能力
keywords.example: Urban resilience is tested during heatwaves and earthquakes.

keywords.meaning: 胎儿人格化；将胎儿或胚胎赋予法律人格的观念
keywords.example: Fetal personhood could reshape reproductive rights.

keywords.meaning: 工作场所安全；包括身体、心理和免受骚扰的安全
keywords.example: Workplace safety must include protection from harassment.

keywords.meaning: 可营销的品牌；能被消费和传播的形象包装
keywords.example: A marketable brand can simplify a complex artist.

keywords.meaning: 数字素养；理解并安全使用数字技术的能力
keywords.example: Digital literacy is becoming part of youth education.

keywords.meaning: 数字主权；对关键数字基础设施和技术系统的掌控能力
keywords.example: Satellite internet is now linked to digital sovereignty.

sentenceLab.sentence: Climate culture can be playful without becoming unserious.
sentenceLab.analysisChinese: 这个句子用 can be... without becoming... 表达一种平衡：气候文化可以有趣、轻盈、有创造力，但不必因此失去严肃性。without 后面接动名词 becoming，表示“在不变成……的情况下”。

reflection.english: The systems that shape the future are often first felt through the body: heat, work, risk, learning and connection.
reflection.chinese: 今天最想留下的一句话是：塑造未来的系统，常常最先通过身体被感受到——热、劳动、风险、学习和连接。
